notes: HUNT H3 pair 7 (heat 2116, dies-lifesteal x end-step death census, single-death contrast). Conclave Mentor (seat 1) blocks the 5/5 Brute: takes 5, dies; 'when this creature dies, you gain life equal to its power' pays its PRINTED 2 (no buff this time - contrast conclave_mentor_x_garruk_unleashed where an enemy EoT +3/+3 was folded into the same trigger at death) -> seat 1 life 22. Brute survives unasserted on the damage ledger: marks are wiped by end_turn cleanup before the runner reads state (H3 rig law, findings doc) - survival is asserted via the zone lane instead. Gadrak (seat 0) end step on end_turn: 'create a Treasure token for each nontoken creature that died this turn' - exactly ONE died, and it belongs to the OPPONENT, but the printed census has no controller qualifier (CR 603.2): Treasure 1. Contrast pair 2 where BOTH blockers and attackers died -> Treasure 2: the two packs bracket the census count. Falsifiers: Treasure 0 (cross-controller census or end-step trigger lost), Treasure 2 (double-count), life 20 (dies trigger lost).
